## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional changes)

- [ ] CI / build system

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the [style guide](CONTRIBUTING.md#code-style)
- [ ] I've run `ruff check` and `ruff format` and they pass
- [ ] I've run `mypy src` and it passes
- [ ] I've added tests for new behavior
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass (`pytest`)
- [ ] I've updated relevant docs (README, ARCHITECTURE, etc.)
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/):
      `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `chore:`, `ci:`
- [ ] PR title follows the same format
